usages.rationale: standard gravity is a conventional reference value, not a location-specific gravity observation; kernels that need spatial gravity must receive it explicitly

Rd, cp, Rv and 1000 hPa are conventional idealized-atmosphere defaults and are caller-overridable model references, not observational state; alternative composition or temperature-dependent properties belong in explicit model parameterization
the numeric coefficients are the published scientific formula itself; replacing them with a live data feed would change the method rather than improve provenance
these are pinned CMIP5 multimodel-mean reference parameters for a controlled two-layer model, not a claim to current observational calibration
the noise scales deliberately create a reproducible structural-identifiability control; real observing-system uncertainty is a separate dataset-backed experiment
equal costs are a negative/structural control and must not be relabeled as acquisition cost evidence
latent ranges, method settings and acceptance guards are fixture/method policy for a known-ground-truth synthetic experiment
the positive temperature-increment degeneracy tolerance is numerical finite-difference policy; no history threshold, observation, radiative forcing, or physical feedback threshold is supplied locally

empirical ice extent belongs to a versioned observation product with missing/source flags, access identity and artifact digest; the numerical sensitivity kernel does not supply or default this observation

radiative conversion of albedo sensitivity requires a retrieved radiative field matched to the declared albedo level and definition, with explicit provenance; no local scalar forcing is an empirical substitute

empirical regional temperature paired to sea-ice and radiation data must come from a declared gridded observation or reanalysis projection with coordinate/time aggregation, uncertainty and missingness recorded

ERA5/IFS hybrid a/b coefficients and surface pressure are source metadata; coefficients should be read from the retrieved GRIB/model-level authority or an explicitly pinned model definition, not copied into an unlabeled local table
station identifiers, locations, observation availability, quality/source flags and values must be discovered/retrieved from a maintained station authority rather than embedded station tuples
global anomaly validation and regional gridded temperature use different appropriate authorities; the projection must name which product and uncertainty/missingness semantics it uses
TOA radiative imbalance and shortwave/longwave terms are observation-product quantities and must not be synthesized from arbitrary fixed forcing constants in empirical validation
real ocean heat content/uptake validation requires a versioned observed product and its depth/time/uncertainty definition rather than arbitrary synthetic scales
the adapter binds provider response records to an explicit request URL and content digest; it does not synthesize station observations when retrieval data are absent
the adapter parses an explicit provider artifact and preserves its source URL and content digest; no local extent series substitutes for the provider file
the CF-aware projection consumes an exact digested GHCN-Daily provider payload, preserves missing observations and provider attributes, and does not synthesize climatology or fallback station values
